title: Experience the locals’ Barcelona and enjoy their food
text: Alexandra weaved her way through the locals part of the city and provided heaps of information on food , country, events, buildings,  history and  lifestyle.  Starting with a Spanish vermouth, we then tasted our way through local markets and back lane bodegas.  I even learned how to drink wine through a spout!
author: Merry_C

title: A must for first timers in Barcelona
text: This is a MUST if this is your first time in Barcelona. You’ll find out where the locals get their groceries and where they eat. Our guide Alex, was charming, knowledgeable, and passionate about her hometown.
author: Helen_C

title: It was a fun activity...
text: It was a fun activity with a great storyteller. We had great samples of food and wine, ending in Tapas and a vermouth cocktail. We had a great time, thank you Francesc.
author: Colleen_F
